hook: CM says dissenting MLAs seem *'bitten by mad dogs'*
hook_b: CM says dissenting MLAs seem *'bitten by mad dogs'*
tldr: At a Siddipet public meeting on Nov 19, CM Revanth Reddy said party members criticising the government publicly but praising it privately would be taken to Erragadda by workers, per IANS via ap7am.

beats.what: He named no one; reports link the remark to MLAs Komatireddy Raj Gopal Reddy and Anirudh Reddy, who had recently criticised the government.
beats.why: Raj Gopal Reddy alleged bias in development fund allocation; Anirudh Reddy alleged officials demand commissions from contractors to clear bills.
beats.care: The row puts the ruling party's internal differences in public view as the remark draws reactions.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: NDTV on Nov 22 reported the remark has sparked a row inside the Telangana Congress.

cards.q: Should ruling-party MLAs air criticism of their government in public?

qs: How do parties usually handle MLAs who criticise their own government?
Does public dissent change how funds get allocated?

facts.t: Harish Rao has represented Siddipet since *2004*, per IANS.

viz.verdict: Public criticism, then the CM's reply on stage

steps.e: Raj Gopal Reddy alleges fund-allocation bias
Anirudh Reddy alleges officials seek commissions
NDTV reports a row in the party

watch: Whether the party leadership responds to the MLAs' complaints on fund allocation and commissions.
